title: Fire Fire Fire

timeline.title: GamePlay Details
bullets: In this puzzle game, players must skillfully stack a variety of objects to create a stable structure that allows fire to reach and burn the target.

Each level provides a set of items—such as wooden blocks, metal beams, and flammable objects—with different weights and properties. Players must drag and drop these items, balancing them carefully to prevent the stack from collapsing.
The challenge lies in ensuring the fire spreads to the target without burning out too quickly or missing the mark.

title: Murgen Horror

timeline.title: GamePlay Details
bullets: This multi-genre game allows players to explore haunted locations, uncover their stories, and defeat main ghosts. In each level, players begin by searching and solving puzzles to find the key to the room where the main ghost resides. Upon entering that room, players engage in combat mode with the ghost.

After defeating the boss, players receive items, clothes, and materials to equip themselves or enhance their camera. These items and equipment can also be purchased in the shop. The game features a blend of 3D third-person exploration, 2D puzzle-solving and searching, and 3D first-person shooter combat.

It is available on the Mirrativ app, which allows players to livestream their gameplay. Viewers can give gifts or gacha to players and chat with them. When there are viewers, players receive a strength boost at the beginning of the game.
Team composition includes a total of 18 individuals, with 8 working in the front-end team, 3 in the back-end team, 1 in project owner, 1 is director, 4 in design , and 1 serving as a tester.

title: LOL LAND

timeline.title: Gameplay & Features
bullets: Monopoly Game Base: Multi-themed game boards based on Monopoly mechanics, including Honey Bearist (nature/camping), Gigachad Bat (baseball stadium), and retro-synthwave themes.
Web3 Prediction Mechanics: Real-time Ethereum price guessing mini-game ('Guess Price Up or Down') integrated directly into the gameplay loop.
NFT Characters & Customization: Gallery of collectible 3D NFT characters (Flipper, Jarvis, Mira, etc.) with customizable rarity-based avatar outfits.
Weekly Tournaments: Global leaderboard system for weekly competitions with tiered rewards based on multipliers.

about: LOL LAND is a fast-paced, browser-based Web3 social board game built on a Monopoly game base where players roll dice to navigate boards, collect symbols, and compete for rewards. It combines casual social casino mechanics with NFT ownership and prediction mini-games like guessing ETH price movements.

I worked on this game during my time at Yield Guild Games as a Game Developer and Technical Artist, responsible for developing gameplay mechanics, integrating user interfaces, and creating shaders/VFX.
